products.geographic_scope: Worldwide or selected regions (areas selected at quote). Domestic travel also covered where destination is >250 km from Home or includes at least one paid night of accommodation.
products.eligibility_rules: Annual business policy. Australian resident with valid Medicare card, or currently living in Australia with a visa allowing you to live, work or study (must be returning Home). Trips must be >250 km from Home, or include at least one night paid accommodation. Leisure travel allowed up to 6 weeks p.a. Family option covers spouse/de facto and Accompanied Children under 21 years.
products.age_eligibility_notes: PDS states the business policy offers cover to travellers up to 74 years; Accompanied Children under 21 years may be covered under family option.
products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: Full refund if cancelled within 21 days of issue, provided you have not started your Journey and have not made a claim. After cooling-off, pro‑rata refund for the unexpired period (less non‑refundable government charges/taxes); no refund if travel has commenced or a claim/right is exercised.

products.limit_basis_notes: Benefits generally per adult per Journey on an Annual Multi‑Trip policy. Automatic reinstatement of limits after completion of each Journey (and once per Journey for Section 4). Sections 14–16 share a combined cap of $45,000. Many limits apply per person per policy period; luggage item limits apply per item/pair/set.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Claims related to Existing Medical Conditions are excluded unless cover is applied for and approved, with any extra premium/conditions shown on the Certificate. A list of specified conditions is automatically included if criteria are met (e.g., Acne, ADHD, Allergy with stability criteria, Asthma under age 60 and stable, etc.). Conditions under investigation/awaiting diagnosis, certain chronic lung/cardiovascular conditions, reduced immunity, pregnancy complications, drug/alcohol dependency and travel against medical advice are not covered unless approved. ‘Relevant Time’ applies.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Limited cover for serious, unexpected complications up to 24th week (23w+6d). Childbirth and newborn care are not covered at any stage. If pregnant at Relevant Time with complications, multiple pregnancy, or assisted conception (e.g., IVF), you must complete medical assessment for eligibility/extra premium.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Cover for trip changes due to the health of a non‑travelling Relative or business partner only if, at the Relevant Time, they: (a) had not been hospitalised in last 12 months for a related condition; (b) were not residing in an aged care/nursing home or similar; (c) lived independently without home/flexible care; (d) were not on a waiting list and did not know they needed surgery/inpatient tests; (e) did not have drug/alcohol addiction; and (f) did not have a Terminal Illness. Otherwise, max $1,000 under all sections combined.

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Cover applies if you hire a Rental Car, are the nominated driver, and have comprehensive motor vehicle insurance for the hire period. Excludes damage while operating in violation of the rental agreement, damage while driven on an unsealed surface, and administration/loss-of-use costs. Optional motorcycle/moped cover can extend excess cover to those vehicles. ‘Rental Car’ includes campervan/motorhome (≤6 tonnes), SUV, sedan, hatchback, people mover, coupe, convertible, 4WD or minibus rented from a licensed company.
products.luggage_conditions: Proof of ownership required (receipts/invoices/bank statements; may accept valuations <2 years old). No cover for valuables checked-in unless forced by security rules. Unattended items in any vehicle overnight not covered; in daytime only if in concealed storage with forced entry and then limited to $500 per item/$2,000 total. No cover for items left Unattended in a Public Place. Report loss/theft within 7 days to police/transport/accommodation; PIR required for airline losses. Depreciation applies per table.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover for claims directly arising from ignoring Smartraveller ‘Do not travel’ advisories for the subject of the advice (except where event unrelated). Sanctions clause prohibits coverage/services where doing so would expose insurer to sanctions (UN/Australia/NZ/EU/UK/Switzerland/USA). COVID-19 sections exclude travel to countries with ‘Do not travel’ due to COVID‑19 at entry (except AU/NZ).
products.claims_process_summary: Claim online at www.claims.covermore.com.au or submit paper form. Provide receipts and supporting documents (e.g., police report/PIR). Original documents may be requested. Notify claims as soon as possible and within 60 days of return date. Assessment outcome within 10 working days after receipt of claim or further information.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 emergency assistance by doctors, nurses, case managers. Contact as soon as possible if hospitalised, medical expenses >$2,000, or wanting to return early. Australia direct & toll free: USA 1800 937 9763; Canada 1800 645 8714; UK 0800 892 014; NZ 0800 445 524. From other countries: +61 2 8907 5619. Have policy number and contact phone number ready.
products.premium_factors: Destination/area, departure date and trip duration, traveller age, chosen excess, selected cancellation cover (where applicable), adding cover for Existing Medical Conditions/pregnancy (if approved), extra cover options/add‑ons.

data._document_notes: This PDS appears to describe a single Cover‑More Business annual multi‑trip plan with selectable maximum trip duration (30/60/90 days).
